# ✨ Unique Feature

🌌 **Mega Evolution System**

Rayquaza undergoes **Mega Evolution** when using an **Empowered Ultimate**, transforming into **Mega Rayquaza**.

🎵 **Dynamic Spawn Music**

- Custom music plays at the **start of each game**  
- Mega Evolution music can be **toggled using the TAB key**  
- Other players can toggle the music as well  

⭐ **Special Mechanic**

At the start of each game, there is a **1% chance to spawn as a shiny variant.**
